assert_eq: assert two values are equal with a descriptive error message on failure
assert_neq: assert two values are not equal with a descriptive error message on failure
assert_lt: assert a value is less than an expected threshold with a descriptive error message
assert_lteq: assert a value is less than or equal to an expected threshold with a descriptive error
assert_tensor_eq: assert two PyTorch tensors are element-wise equal within a tolerance and debug on mismatch
